subject: showcase
caption:
Can I bring someone. What should I wear. What if I said yes and something came up.

You will answer these maybe fifty times if there is nowhere else for them to live. Every one of them arrives as a separate message, usually late at night, usually from someone you love.

Write them once. Put them on the page. They stop coming to you.

Send us your event date and we will help you decide what belongs there.
